name: KeePassXC Cleanup
tagline: CLI tool to find and remove duplicate entries in KeePassXC databases
description:
A Python command-line tool that helps clean up KeePassXC databases. It scans all entries and groups potential duplicates by a composite key built from the entry URL or app ID, username, and password.

It provides an interactive deduplication flow: for every set of duplicates it lists the matching entries with their internal paths and asks which entry to keep before saving the database. It can also report which custom properties exist across all entries, which helps to standardize and tidy up entries.
purpose: To keep KeePassXC databases tidy and secure by detecting redundant entries, letting users safely remove duplicates after review, and highlighting inconsistent custom property usage.
strengths: Detects duplicates based on URL/app ID, username, and password combination
Interactive dedup flow lets you choose exactly which entry to keep per duplicate set
Masks passwords in output so they are never printed in plain text
Lists custom property usage to help identify and standardize non-standard entries
limitations: Deduplication is interactive only; there is no non-interactive batch mode
Entries without a URL or app ID may not be grouped correctly
Requires the database master password to be entered interactively via prompt
installation:
git clone git@github.com:chrisb09/keepassxc_cleanup.git
cd keepassxc_cleanup
python install_requirements.py
usage:
# List duplicate entries:
python main.py <path_to_database> list_duplicates

# Remove duplicate entries after review:
python main.py <path_to_database> dedup

# List custom properties of all entries:
python main.py <path_to_database> list_custom_properties
roadmap: Support unlocking databases with key files
